title: Cinco Funções
summary: In a full day of situational drills, self-assessment, and a peer vote, the five Kairos Academy Green players are assigned current roles for the first time: soupcrime as IGL / Rifler, velcrodog as Entry Rifler, parkinglot as Lurker / Rifler, dentalplan as Primary AWPer, and wrongnumber as Anchor / Support Rifler. The captaincy is explicitly left TBD. This is the last full training day before the 2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03 institutional break.
keyEvents: Stewie2K, Trace, Maya Torres, and Evelyn Park run the five CS Academy players through pressure-judgment exercises and four hours of role-rotation Counter-Strike drills.

Each player is tested across multiple responsibilities during the drills (e.g. velcrodog on entry timing, dentalplan with and without the AWP, parkinglot on map-presence timing, wrongnumber on anchor discipline, soupcrime on round-opening calls).
In the afternoon, all five players privately vote on which role they would choose for themselves and for each of the other four.

The vote results are almost unanimous: dentalplan (Primary AWPer, 5 votes), velcrodog (Entry Rifler, 4 votes), parkinglot (Lurker / Rifler, 5 votes), wrongnumber (Anchor / Support Rifler, 4 votes), and soupcrime (IGL / Rifler, 5 votes).
Evelyn Park cautions the group not to let a role become part of their identity, and that an IGL does not have to make every decision alone.
Stewie2K writes the five current roles on the board under the heading CURRENT ROLES (changed from an initial POSITIONS heading), then writes 'Captain: TBD' beneath it.
Stewie2K explicitly states that being IGL and being captain are not the same decision, and the captaincy is not assigned in this episode.
The institutional break begins the next day, 2026-12-20, running through 2027-01-03.
consequences: The CS Academy roster has current (not necessarily permanent) roles for the first time, used going into the institutional break and reconfirmed on return in episode-093.
